messages:
sara: quick heads-up — I hit a 404 in the runtime guide under the `kv-cache` section, and the diagram also has missing alt text. path: `/docs/runtime/kv-cache.md` (around line ~142). staging preview shows the image 403-ing. who owns this page?

devon: @sara i can take it. can you paste the exact image url you saw fail? :eyes:

sara: it’s `https://cdn.internal.redwood/assets/kv-diagram.png` — staging returned 403. also saw `alt:` blank. minimal fix: rehost to `/assets/docs/runtime/kv-cache/kv-diagram.png` and add `alt="KV cache diagram"`.

elaine: heads up docs squad — we have a short merge window at 11:30 PT for the doc push. if this is a tiny PR (rehost + alt + 1-line caption) i can queue it in that slot.

devon: working on a micro-PR now. patch includes `sed` replace for the path and adds `alt` + small caption. WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8123

mike: @devon i can do a fast review. please ensure the new image path is on the CDN whitelist and the filename is checksumed (so caching behaves).

devon: pushed changes, added filename `kv-diagram-20260321.png` and updated docs frontmatter. diff snippet:
```diff
- ![ ](https://cdn.internal.redwood/assets/kv-diagram.png)
+ ![KV cache diagram](https://cdn.internal.redwood/assets/docs/runtime/kv-cache/kv-diagram-20260321.png)
```

docs-bot: PR #8123 build passed :white_check_mark: staging preview: https://staging.redwood-inference/docs/runtime/kv-cache

mike: quick pass done, one nit on caption wording (prefer "KV cache — prefix caching flow"). left a single comment on the PR.

devon: updated caption to "KV cache — prefix caching flow" and pushed.

mike: LGTM :shipit: merging during the 11:30 PT docs window.

sara: amazing — thanks everyone. will verify staging preview after merge and close the incident if green. :thumbsup:
